info.title: SmartERP API
info.description:
## Overview

SmartERP is a billing, inventory, and accounting ERP backend.

This API provides endpoints for managing the resources and
operations supported by SmartERP.

## API Versioning

The current API uses the `/api/v1` version prefix.

## Using This Documentation

Explore the available endpoints to understand their HTTP methods,
parameters, request bodies, and responses.

As the API documentation expands, additional resource groups
and detailed request and response examples will be included.

post.description:
Creates a new measurement unit for a company in SmartERP.

### Access requirements

- **Authentication:** Required.
- **Company access:** The user must have access to the specified company.
- **Required role:** `owner` or `manager`.

### When should I use this endpoint?

Use this endpoint to create a measurement unit that can be used
when managing inventory, such as Kilogram, Litre, or Piece.

### Before sending the request

1. Authenticate the user.
2. Provide the company ID in the URL.
3. Send the unit details as a JSON request body.

parameters.name: company_id
parameters.description: Unique ID of the company in which the unit will be created.

requestBody.description: Details of the measurement unit to create.

name.description: Full name of the measurement unit.

short_name.description: Short abbreviation used to identify the unit.

201.description:
**Unit created successfully.**

The server accepted the request and created the new measurement unit.

400.description:
**Invalid request data.**

Check that the submitted unit details satisfy the API's validation rules.

401.description:
**Authentication required.**

Provide valid authentication credentials before accessing this endpoint.

403.description:
**Access denied.**

The authenticated user may not have access to this company
or may not have the required `owner` or `manager` role.

get.summary: Get all units for a company
get.description: Retrieves units belonging to the specified company.
Retrieves one unit belonging to the specified company.

patch.description: Updates a unit belonging to a company. Requires owner or manager permissions.
